self_assessment: Moved caching out of the gRPC middleware and into the storage decorator. internal/storage/cache/cache.go now has typed helpers setJSON/getJSON (used by the evaluation rules and rollouts paths) and setProtobuf/getProtobuf, plus a delete helper, all logging errors rather than propagating them. Added GetFlag caching under the s:f:<namespace>:<key> prefix using protobuf serialization, and UpdateFlag, DeleteFlag, CreateVariant, UpdateVariant and DeleteVariant now invalidate that key before delegating - the decorator still embeds storage.Store so it satisfies the interface. Deleted CacheUnaryInterceptor along with its flagCacheKey/evaluationCacheKey/evaluationRequest helpers and the now-unused cache and proto imports, and removed its registration from internal/cmd/grpc.go (the storagecache.NewStore wiring there was already in place). Verified: go build ./... clean and gofmt clean; a written test confirmed the s:f key format, that a hit round-trips the flag through protobuf without re-setting, and that all five mutations invalidate the entry - run alongside the existing cache tests, all passing. The two remaining build failures are exactly the mandated API changes (cache_test.go still calls the old set/get names, middleware_test.go still references CacheUnaryInterceptor); the redis and gitfs package failures need docker/network and fail identically on the clean base.
